# PureLifePartner

> PureLifePartner (purelifepartner.com) is a global halal Muslim marriage website for Muslims anywhere in the world who are seeking a spouse for nikah, with members across the UK, Europe, North America, the Middle East, South Asia and beyond. Members create a free profile, browse and search verified Muslim marriage profiles, and contact each other once both are verified. Profiles are private by default, real names and phone numbers are never shown publicly, and families and a wali (guardian) can be involved.

Key facts:
- Type: Muslim matrimonial service (online Muslim marriage website and marriage bureau)
- Audience: single, divorced and widowed Muslims worldwide seeking marriage, and their families
- Coverage: worldwide; members can search by country, city and sect
- Free to join; verification is a paid one-off step confirmed by an admin, usually within 24 hours
- Fees can be paid in GBP, PKR, EUR or USD
- Contact details are released only when both members are verified
- Members can limit photos and video to verified members only
- Human support by WhatsApp (+44 7748 528207) and email
